title: Thread a currency option through three modules
description:
Add multi-currency support to the `shop` package under `src/shop/`:
1. `config.SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES` must list "USD", "EUR" and "JPY".
2. `pricing.format_money(amount, currency="USD")`: USD -> `$1,234.50`, EUR -> `€1,234.50`, JPY -> `¥1,235` (no decimals); any currency not in `SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES` raises `ValueError`.
3. `receipt.render_receipt(items, tax_rate, currency="USD")` formats every amount in that currency.
Existing call sites without a currency must keep working.
success_criteria: Hidden cases covering all three modules pass, including the unchanged default behaviour.
